history.summary: Very large 99-yr EC-style 4BR (2,476sqft) at $1,292 PSF, 510m from Choa Chu Kang MRT in D23, priced at $3.2M. The low PSF is purely a size artifact — a $3.2M quantum for a 99-yr OCR/Choa Chu Kang unit is well outside the liquid band, and there is no URA series to verify any trend.
history.rating_rationale: A $3.2M, 99-yr leasehold, 2,476sqft unit in Choa Chu Kang is a fundamentally illiquid investment: the OCR buyer pool at $3M+ is extremely shallow, the cheap $1,292 PSF is just the huge floorplate, and 99-yr lease decay erodes the hold. No appreciation/txn data to underwrite it. MRT proximity (510m) and TOP 2015 are fine, but they don't fix a quantum/lease/location mismatch. For investment, avoid.
